name: 银河英雄传说
english_description: A rare science-fiction reskin in a corpus otherwise dominated by wuxia settings: an ES II-engine MUD (master.c credits "original by Lil, rewritten by Annihilator") redesigned around Yoshiki Tanaka's novel/anime series Legend of the Galactic Heroes. New characters are born at the Fezzan Central Spaceport, the neutral trade-hub setting fans of the source material will recognize, and roll military-flavored stats (Strength/Courage/Intellect/Command/Composure/Charisma/Constitution/Luck) alongside separately-tracked combat and command experience, a fleet win/loss record, and progress on a "Galactic Mission Board." Naming is explicitly restricted to keep the roster original — canon character names like Yang Wenli and Reinhard are blocklisted at registration. A rare inter-city taxi system, paid for with an ID card, is also unusual for this collection.
